Hi Tanya — thanks for the packet, received and looks mostly complete. Quick asks before finance kicks off activation:

1) Remit reference: please confirm the exact remittance string you prefer on our payments (we typically include "Invoice # / PO # / Vendor Name"). If Lumenix wants a specific tag (e.g., LUM-INV), confirm here.

2) Verification method: Redwood requires one of the following to activate ACH:
   - ACH micro-deposit verification (we make two small deposits and you confirm amounts), OR
   - Bank letter on official letterhead + voided check (PDF).

3) For wire fallbacks, please confirm beneficiary name exactly as it should appear and whether the account is a single-signature or multi-signature account (this affects our audit).

If you want micro-deposits, we can kick those from our treasury team today — they typically hit within 1-2 business days. If you prefer DocuSign for secure transfer of full account numbers, share the email for signing and I'll route internally.

Once you confirm, I'll loop in Vivek in Payments to schedule activation and map the PO-11234 remit path.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
